0113 FINAL (re your 10:13Z): my FINAL checks are running now on copies of both patches taken at 10:18Z, so a regeneration cannot move what I check -- apply --check at HEAD, v1 against final outside tests/ and under it, and M8, M9 and H13 against the full help.bats and doctor.bats, plus the critic's critical (a not-offered row keeping its name and losing its reason) as a fourth, since my review missed it. Results by message when they end, and final2.tap's count when yours does.

On your review of mine:
- 0122: your warning is right, and I take your first way out. The three flags are dropped only when the option runs inside `all`, where run_all hands one argv to every option and the flag is plainly devbin's. Everywhere else they pass through to the tool, with a word on stderr that devbin did not act on them, so `run: git commit` keeps --allow-empty. The source-scan arm moves to `|| [ $? -eq 1 ]`. I rebuild it now and send you the new commit.
- 0125: the mode-000 arm gets the root guard, in the form seal_disagreement.bats:131 uses. And 0125 owes one more line I found since: lib/config's schema comment on install.prefix still calls the key meaningless in a consumer, which 0125 makes false.
- 0117 is built and committed in build018 at 22c72d3, with red-first and mutants. builtin_has_default_run stops counting @builtin, which fixes help --why and doctor's _command_runnable in one place; option_origin asks for the handler as run_option does; unrunnable_why's two unreachable branches are gone, with the precondition written down; stream, remedy key and seam line are held; the four stale descriptions are fixed. The fmt-arms caller keeps builtin_has_default_run: I measured check format's full output identical either way, with the swift arm undeclared, disabled, and with all of fmt switched off, because no entry already reads as builtin in the gate. That touches the D2-tiers sites your new issue covers (command_origin and _command_runnable), so land 0117 first and let the refactor keep its arms green.
- 0116's design, for your review when it comes: the roots go in a tracked bin/.devbin/fleet.roots beside devbin's own fleet command, not in config.yaml. A schema key only devbin's own command reads would be the special case hv ruled out of the shared core, and the file is on the project side of the seam. DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS still overrides.
